{{Quote|Well, I must say, it's absolutely charming. Those falling down buildings are a real nice touch.|Han Solo|<ref name="M70">[[Star Wars (1977) 70|''Star Wars'' (1977) 70]]</ref>}}
'''Stenos''' was a planet located in the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Stenax]] race.

==History==
Stenos was originally named '''Maldont''' while it was a part of [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> when the Stenax were enslaved by [[Xim/Legends|the despot]].<ref name="XimHistory">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> Stenos was a world of pinnacles and plateaus, where the winged Stenax built most of their structures. Several hundred years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a series of earthquakes and volcanic disturbances shook the planet. One quake buried the stone idol believed by the Stenax to be the worldly avatar of their god, [[Vol]], and the Stenax refused to fly until the idol was found.<ref name="M70" /> Many of their ancient buildings became ruins due to centuries of neglect, including the city of [[Farruz]]. The Stenos capital city later became a crowded haven for criminals from various worlds.

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], former [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Quorl Matrin]] was appointed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Stenos, but was killed by the Stenax for sacrilege once the idol of Vol was recovered, thanks to the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] and [[Rik Duel/Legends|Rik Duel's]] gang. When Duel made the Stenax believe Matrin had stolen the idol, the governor and many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were killed by a swarm of Stenaxes. The Stenax again took to the air, and mostly ignored the non-Stenax population of the planet.<ref name="M70" /> Years later, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] met Duel's gang on Stenos and ran afoul of bounty hunters while searching for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="M71">[[Star Wars (1977) 71|''Star Wars'' (1977) 71]]</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Barquin D'an/Legends|Barquin D'an]] built up an import/export business on the planet after leaving the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="Rebo">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref> In that same era, former criminal [[Barpotomous Drebble/Legends|Barpotomous Drebble]] became the benevolent leader of a large section of the planet's capital city.<ref name="M99">[[Star Wars (1977) 99|''Star Wars'' (1977) 99]]</ref> Ten months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the native Stenax population massacred the Imperial garrison occupying Stenos, as well as all non-Stenaxes in what was only the beginning of the [[Stenax Massacres]].<ref name="MSeries">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars (1977) 79|''Star Wars'' 79]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] refers to this planet as ''[[Stenax]]'', the name of its native species.
